origin.summary: Beta architecture draft for an executable, typed workflow runtime independent of the Workflow Studio canvas layout.

events.note: Created from the workflow-runtime and typed-result-routing design discussion.
Implemented the in-process workflow runtime beta with typed routing, native flow nodes, internal tool execution, and focused tests. Durable instances and publication remain deferred.
Added a reusable sequential definition for system volume, greeting, and Toonverse search using the installed tool contracts.
Added a named manual-run HTTP route and Studio result rendering, then completed one live run successfully.
